title: The overnight plays a loop on the night the farm changed
tier_reason: The first Lab loops reach players through this; it lengthens the sleep and touches the one moment the game already holds input.
ask: Build P-15's overnight player. The sleep today is tuck-in (0.45s), fade to black (0.5s), hold with the Day-N card (0.5s), fade in (0.5s) in systems/day_cycle.gd, with input swallowed throughout (main.gd, T-27). On a night the farm crossed a named threshold, the hold plays that threshold's loop once, centred, at the sheet's own scale, then the Day-N card as today. Rules for the first version, all deliberate: one loop per night, once per farm (a flag in the save so it never repeats), no skip, and the fade's colour becomes the Lab's sky (33,31,32) rather than pure black so the loop's canvas never shows as a box — check that the day card still reads on that colour. The loop is drawn from assets/anim/<slug>/ (sheet + manifest, from item w1a08ee15302). Two triggers, both derived from world state at the sleep, never from a timer: (1) the crow night — the first sleep where no acorn remains on the ground AND four or more tomatoes stand (see design/04, 'The morning after'); play crow_gorge. (2) the robot night — the first sleep after the Mark III becomes available under S-12 (the desk is placed); play seeder_bot. The D-8 constraint is unchanged: the sleep has already resolved through apply_action before the hold begins; the loop only lengthens presentation; headless runs skip it entirely, so the unit and robot suites are untouched. Add an integration test that a story night lengthens the hold and a plain night does not, and that a save made the morning after does not replay it. Do not build the morning raid (that is the sim item filed alongside); only the night.
first_action: Read systems/day_cycle.gd and the T-27 input-swallow block in main.gd, then decide where the loop draws so it sits under the day card and over the fade.
source_message: Filed from the 2026-09-10 brainstorm on where the Animation Lab loops enter play (P-15, S-12).
